description.en:
Moves a character in a straight line from _start to _end ([x, y, z, rotY]) over _frame frames, one step per frame with CMND_SET_POSRY and suspend(). Each value is clamped so it does not go past its end value.
Note: the rotation clamp is mistyped in the script and writes the end rotation into z instead of the rotation, so when the rotation overshoots, the z position jumps to that value for the frame. No shipped script calls it.

examples.case: Sliding a model into place (not found in script_clean/; invented)
